records.jp: 自分だけが、残ってしまった
records.en_original: I'm the only one left behind.
records.en: I'm the only one left behind.

records.jp: いや、彼女たちに残された、という方が正しいだろう
records.en_original: No, it's more like...they left me behind.
records.en: No, it's more like...they left me behind.

records.jp: 駒川たちが動けなくなっても、侵食は続くようだ
records.en_original: Even if Uta and the others can't move anymore, the corruption keeps spreading.
records.en: Even if Uta and the others can't move anymore, the corruption keeps spreading.

records.jp: リーダーくん
records.en_original: Leader.
records.en: Leader.

records.jp: あなたの武器はそれじゃないはず。思い出して
records.en_original: That isn't your real weapon. Remember!
records.en: That isn't your real weapon. Remember!

records.jp: リーダーくん
records.en_original: Leader.
records.en: Leader.

records.jp: あなたがもし本当に、みんなのために役立てるなら<CR>いくらでも自分を使ってほしいと思ってるなら
records.en_original: If you really want to help everyone, if you honestly want them to use you however they need...
records.en: If you really want to help everyone, if you honestly want them to use you however they need...

records.jp: みんなの命を、想いを繋ぐためなら、<CR>自分はどうなってもいいと心から思えるなら
records.en_original: If you seriously think it's okay no matter what happens to you, as long as you connect everyone's lives and feelings...
records.en: If you seriously think it's okay no matter what happens to you, as long as you connect everyone's lives and feelings...

records.jp: あなたには役割がある。<CR>この世界とコモンを切り離す以外の、もう一つの役割
records.en_original: You have another role. There's something else for you to do besides just severing this world from the Common.
records.en: You have another role. There's something else for you to do besides just severing this world from the Common.

records.jp: さすがリーダーくん。<CR>コモンから直接行かなくても、ここに辿り着いたね
records.en_original: As expected from you, Leader. Even without going through the Common, you managed to make it here.
records.en: As expected from you, Leader. Even without going through the Common, you managed to make it here.

records.jp: ここはコモンの中枢
records.en_original: This is the core of the Common.
records.en: This is the core of the Common.

records.jp: 魂の区別なく、全てが溶け合う場所。<CR>集合的無意識の集積地
records.en_original: A place where all souls mix together, without any boundaries. It's a gathering point for the collective unconscious.
records.en: A place where all souls mix together, without any boundaries. It's a gathering point for the collective unconscious.

records.jp: まぁ、ユズたちはちょっと特別だから、<CR>こんな感じで話せてるけど
records.en_original: Well, Lime and I are a little special, so that's why we can talk like this.
records.en: Well, Lime and I are a little special, so that's why we can talk like this.

records.jp: リーダーくんのもう一つの役割。<CR>それは「想いをまとめる者」
records.en_original: Your other role, Leader, is to be the "One who gathers everyone's feelings."
records.en: Your other role, Leader, is to be the "One who gathers everyone's feelings."

records.jp: ユズたちは元々、その使命のために<CR>あなたを「呼んだ」の
records.en_original: Lime and I originally "called" you here for that very mission.
records.en: Lime and I originally "called" you here for that very mission.

records.jp: ここではない世界から。<CR>そして、それは一度目じゃない
records.en_original: From a world that's not this one. And, this isn't the first time.
records.en: From a world that's not this one. And, this isn't the first time.

records.jp: 正直、今回も男の子だし、ハズレだと思っていたけど、<CR>結果的にはかなり良かった
records.en_original: Honestly, I thought since we'd gotten a boy this time, it might be a flop, but things turned out pretty well in the end.
records.en: Honestly, I thought since we'd gotten a boy this time, it might be a flop, but things turned out pretty well in the end.

records.jp: もしかして、まだ３回前のこと根に持ってるの？<CR>そっちの方がたまたまだよ
records.en_original: Wait, are you still holding a grudge from three times ago? That one was seriously just bad luck.
records.en: Wait, are you still holding a grudge from three times ago? That one was seriously just bad luck.

records.jp: ３回前は大変だったよね。<CR>だって、その役割が悠……
records.en_original: Three times ago really was rough. Because, the one who had that role was Yu—
records.en: Three times ago really was rough. Because, the one who had that role was Yu—

records.jp: 今はそんな話をしてる場合じゃない
records.en_original: This isn't the time to be talking about that.
records.en: This isn't the time to be talking about that.

records.jp: あなたの持つ能力、エーテルフェログラムは、実は……
records.en_original: The ability you have, the Ether Pherogram...
records.en: The ability you have, the Ether Pherogram...

records.jp: イローデッド、そしてリフレクターの想いを<CR>束ねる力なの
records.en_original: It's actually the power to bring together the feelings of the Eroded and Reflectors.
records.en: It's actually the power to bring together the feelings of the Eroded and Reflectors.

records.jp: 束は絆によって育まれ、その精度は次の世界の品質に<CR>大きく影響する
records.en_original: That cohesion grows through bonds, and the quality of those connections has a huge influence on the next world.
records.en: That cohesion grows through bonds, and the quality of those connections has a huge influence on the next world.

records.jp: 想いの束を限りなく高純度にするためには、<CR>彼女たちの心を整える必要があった
records.en_original: To make their feelings as pure as possible, we had to help them sort out their hearts.
records.en: To make their feelings as pure as possible, we had to help them sort out their hearts.

records.jp: その方法はあなたがエーテルフェログラムを使って<CR>彼女たちを強化すること
records.en_original: And the way to do that was for you to use your Ether Pherogram to strengthen them.
records.en: And the way to do that was for you to use your Ether Pherogram to strengthen them.

records.jp: そして、彼女たちと交流を深めること
records.en_original: And, for you to deepen your bonds with them.
records.en: And, for you to deepen your bonds with them.

records.jp: でも、役割を果たしたら……<CR>あなたはこの世界から消えてしまうことになる
records.en_original: But once you've fulfilled your role...you'll end up disappearing from this world.
records.en: But once you've fulfilled your role...you'll end up disappearing from this world.

records.jp: 想いを捧げる彼女たちよりも、<CR>恐らくずっと高い可能性で
records.en_original: Probably with a much higher chance than even the girls offering their hearts.
records.en: Probably with a much higher chance than even the girls offering their hearts.

records.jp: あなたにみんなの想いを集めて、一つの意志にして、<CR>あなたを核に雫世界を創ることになるから
records.en_original: Because you're going to gather everyone's feelings into one will and use yourself as the core to create the Oasis.
records.en: Because you're going to gather everyone's feelings into one will and use yourself as the core to create the Oasis.

records.jp: だから今回も、前回も、前々回も……<CR>他に方法がないか、ずっと探してきた
records.en_original: That's why this time, last time, and the time before that, we've kept looking for some other way.
records.en: That's why this time, last time, and the time before that, we've kept looking for some other way.

records.jp: それでやっと見つけて、その方法で雫世界を創ろうと<CR>してたんだけど……
records.en_original: We finally found one and were about to use that to create the Oasis, but...
records.en: We finally found one and were about to use that to create the Oasis, but...

records.jp: コモンの内部まで異灰が侵食してしまった今では、<CR>もう難しくて……
records.en_original: But now that the inside of the Common's been eaten away by Testa, it's basically impossible.
records.en: But now that the inside of the Common's been eaten away by Testa, it's basically impossible.

records.jp: 「想いを束ねた後はどうすれば？」
records.en_original: What should I do after gathering everyone's feelings?
records.en: What should I do after gathering everyone's feelings?

records.jp: 時を繋ぐ者に受け渡してほしいの
records.en_original: You need to pass them on to the one who connects time.
records.en: You need to pass them on to the one who connects time.

records.jp: それが私
records.en_original: And that's me.
records.en: And that's me.

records.jp: なんか格好いい響き。<CR>こんな状況じゃなきゃ、素直に喜べたんだけど……
records.en_original: It actually sounds kinda cool. If only it wasn't in a situation like this, I'd be really happy about it...
records.en: It actually sounds kinda cool. If only it wasn't in a situation like this, I'd be really happy about it...

records.jp: 今回の束はバッチリだよ。めっちゃいい感じだもん
records.en_original: The cohesion this time is perfect. It just feels awesome.
records.en: The cohesion this time is perfect. It just feels awesome.

records.jp: 前回、前々回は「想いをまとめる者」の力が足りなくて<CR>僅かなリフレクターたちだけで世界を拓いた
records.en_original: The other times, the one gathering everyone's feelings wasn't strong enough, so only a few Reflectors could open the way to a new world.
records.en: The other times, the one gathering everyone's feelings wasn't strong enough, so only a few Reflectors could open the way to a new world.

records.jp: けど、今回はこんなにたくさんの仲間がいる。<CR>遙かに安定した世界を拓くことができるはず
records.en_original: But this time, we have so many friends by our side. I'm sure we can create a world that's way more stable than before.
records.en: But this time, we have so many friends by our side. I'm sure we can create a world that's way more stable than before.

records.jp: それはリーダーくんがたくさん頑張って、<CR>あの子たちを想ってくれたおかげだね
records.en_original: That's because you, Leader, worked so hard and cared about everyone so much.
records.en: That's because you, Leader, worked so hard and cared about everyone so much.

records.jp: うん、リーダーくんは本当によく頑張ってくれた
records.en_original: Yeah, you really did your best, Leader.
records.en: Yeah, you really did your best, Leader.

records.jp: 最初に「期待してる」って言ったと思うけど、<CR>期待以上の人だったよ
records.en_original: I think I said, "We're counting on you," at the start, but you turned out to be even more amazing than I expected.
records.en: I think I said, "We're counting on you," at the start, but you turned out to be even more amazing than I expected.

records.jp: さあ、リーダーくん
records.en_original: All right, Leader...
records.en: All right, Leader...

records.jp: 世界の創造を始めよう
records.en_original: Let's begin the creation of a new world.
records.en: Let's begin the creation of a new world.
